# `pygeovision report`

Rebuild the map, vectors and reports of an earlier pipeline run without re-running it. See
[Rebuilding reports](../../reporting/rebuilding.md).

## When to use it

Use it to add a format (PDF, Word, Excel, shapefile, KML), to name the classes of a network you trained, or to retitle a report.

## What you get

The report and vector files are (re)written inside the run folder; nothing is downloaded or re-analysed.

## Things to know

Needs the run folder from a `channel` run (output rasters and `run_summary.json`).

## Commands

### `pygeovision report`

Rebuild the map, vectors and reports of an earlier pipeline run.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `OUTPUT_DIR` | path | yes |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--formats` | text | `pdf,xlsx,docx` |  | Report formats: pdf, xlsx, docx ('none' for none). |
| `--vector-formats` | text | `gpkg,geojson` |  | Vector formats: gpkg, geojson, shp, kml ('none' for none). |
| `--class-names` | text |  |  | Comma-separated class names for a trained network's classes 0,1,2... |
| `--title` | text |  |  | Replace the report title. |
| `--no-vectors` | flag | off |  | Do not write vector files. |
| `--no-maps` | flag | off |  | Do not draw maps and charts. |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision report [OPTIONS] OUTPUT_DIR

  Rebuild the map, vectors and reports of an earlier pipeline run.

  OUTPUT_DIR is the -o directory of a `pygeovision channel` run. Nothing is downloaded or re-
  analysed: the output rasters and run_summary.json are read. Use it to add a format (for
  example --formats pdf,docx --vector-formats shp,kml) or to name the classes of a network you
  trained.

Options:
  --formats TEXT         Report formats: pdf, xlsx, docx ('none' for none).  [default:
                         pdf,xlsx,docx]
  --vector-formats TEXT  Vector formats: gpkg, geojson, shp, kml ('none' for none).  [default:
                         gpkg,geojson]
  --class-names TEXT     Comma-separated class names for a trained network's classes 0,1,2...
  --title TEXT           Replace the report title.
  --no-vectors           Do not write vector files.
  --no-maps              Do not draw maps and charts.
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
```
:::
